extDescription.message: Post pages, links and selections to Misskey through NoteDeck, and open Misskey notes and users in NoteDeck.

cmdComposePage.message: Open NoteDeck's post form with this page

menuComposeImage.message: Post this image's URL via NoteDeck

notifyNotMisskeyUrl.message: This is not a Misskey note or user URL.

notifyTokenRequired.message: Opening a user needs an API token. Set one in the extension options.

popupPosting.message: Confirm the post in the NoteDeck window…

popupNoToken.message: Posting directly needs an API token. The post form button works without one.

optionsBaseUrlHelp.message: Base URL of NoteDeck's built-in HTTP API. Leave the default unless you changed the port or run a development build.

optionsTokenHelp.message: Issued in NoteDeck: Settings → Permissions → API tokens. Name it "browser" so NoteDeck shows where requests come from. Only needed for posting directly and for opening users; everything else works through notedeck:// links.

optionsNoAccounts.message: Connected, but NoteDeck has no accounts.

errUnreachable.message: NoteDeck is not running (or the API URL is wrong).

errUnauthorized.message: Invalid API token. Issue one in NoteDeck: Settings → Permissions → API tokens.

errPermissionDenied.message: Not allowed for external tools. Allow it under Settings → Permissions → External.
